episodeTitle: Guddi Didi Ki Shaadi Ke 12 Lakh Gayab!

realBreachParallel.incident: DoT Advisory (PIB Release ID 1995304, 11 Jan 2024) USSD *401# / *21* Call-Forwarding Fraud & MHA I4C 1930 (cybercrime.gov.in)
realBreachParallel.impact: Fraudsters trick mobile users into dialing unconditional call-forwarding USSD codes (*21* / *401#) so incoming voice calls and Bank IVR OTP verification calls route silently to attacker-controlled SIMs
realBreachParallel.lesson: Never hand an unlocked phone to anyone even for two minutes to place a call, and dial *#21# to verify zero active voice-call or IVR OTP forwarding.

postCopy.instagramCaption: Subah beti ki doli uthne wali thi, magar aadhi raat Sharma Ji ke pairon tale zameen khisak gayi — shaadi account se poore Rs 12 Lakh saaf! Phone shaam se Puja Ghar mein band rakha tha, na koi anjaan call aaya na link khula — par Cyber Jasoos ki jaanch mein khula ki sangeet ke shor mein theek 7:42 PM par kisi ne chupke se *21* call-forwarding lagayi, jisse bank ki saari IVR OTP calls chhat par chalu ek farzi SIM par jaa rahi thin! Shak ke ghere mein 3 apne hain: A) Pados Ka Golu (7:40 PM 2 minute phone maangkar phone off aur gayab), B) Ramu Kaka (7:42 PM Puja Ghar ke paas, jeb mein naye SIM ka packet), ya C) Pappu Chachu (5 Lakh maange, 11:25 PM chhat par chupke baat karte dikhe). Asli gaddar kaun hai? Neeche A, B, ya C comment kijiye!

postCopy.linkedinPost:
Live Terrace SIM & The *21* Voice-OTP Call-Forwarding Trap — Case #01 (Cyber Jasoos):

Per DoT Advisory (PIB Release ID 1995304, 11 Jan 2024) and MHA I4C 1930 (cybercrime.gov.in), even when a smartphone sits untouched in the Puja room all evening, a brief unlocked moment during wedding festivities lets an insider dial USSD *21* unconditional call forwarding (logged at 7:42 PM) to divert Bank IVR 'Call-Me' voice OTP calls — and live tower trace shows the rogue SIM is still active on the wedding house terrace!

Three insiders, three guilty secrets: A) Golu (7:40 PM 2 minute phone maangkar gayab, now unreachable), B) Ramu Kaka (7:42 PM Puja room, new SIM packet in pocket), or C) Pappu Chachu (asked Rs 5L, whispering on terrace at 11:25 PM). Who is the real culprit?
